lines.zh: 我在空中慢慢画了个圈。
lines.en: I draw a slow circle in the air.
My membrane catches the wind and I glide.

lines.zh: 我的头冠在阳光下很艳。
lines.en: My crest is vivid in the sun.
I pass over the enclosure.
I land on my wrists.
I follow the cliff for a while.
On the ground I can only shuffle.

lines.zh: 翅膀一收，我就矮了半格。
lines.en: Folding my wings, I drop half a block.
I perch on a dead branch.
Not high, but steady.
I glide along an updraft.
I duck through a gap in the trees.
I skim the water without touching.
I launch from a high ledge.

lines.zh: 我挂在岩壁上，爪扣着石。
lines.en: I cling to the rock face.

lines.zh: 头冠是我最显眼的地方。
lines.en: My crest is the boldest thing about me.
I wait for a thermal.
Wings folded neatly at my sides.
My crest blocks half the sun.
Wind up here is cleaner.

lines.zh: 我在看下面有没有动静。
lines.en: I watch below for movement.
I shake dust from my crest.
On the ledge, I look like colored stone.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑道，风就够了。
lines.en: I need no runway. Wind is enough.
I count clouds above the canopy.

lines.zh: 爪子抓得很牢，掉不下去。
lines.en: My claws hold. I will not fall.
My long beak opens to catch the cool air.
Someone walks below.

lines.zh: 彩色头冠在阳光下发亮。
lines.en: My colorful crest shines in the sun.
My crest. First time for you?

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就不下来。
lines.en: Stand still and I stay up here.

lines.zh: 你的影子很小，从上面看。
lines.en: Your shadow looks small from above.
Your scent is new to me.
Do not throw. I dodge.

lines.zh: 你想看我的翅膀展开吗？
lines.en: Want to see my wings spread?
This ledge is mine.

lines.zh: 我飞起来，你就看不清了。
lines.en: Once I fly, you lose me.
That net cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 我在上面看得比你想的清楚。
lines.en: I see more from here.
Your footsteps carry far.
A tear in my membrane.
I fly two blocks off course.
My wings beat, down drifting loose.
I drop to the ledge to rest.
That brought me lower.
I do not cry out. Pterosaurs are quiet.
One claw has snapped.
One breath, then I take off.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了你的方向。
lines.en: I know which way you stand now.
I can still fly. Do not hurry.
Fish? Not very interested.

lines.zh: 你把肉举起来，我看见了。
lines.en: I see the meat you raise.
Set it on the ledge and I will come.
Not carrion. Take it away.
Is that ripe fruit?

lines.zh: 你手抬太高，我不下来了。
lines.en: Too high. I am not coming down.

lines.zh: 我的头冠比身体还显眼。
lines.en: My crest stands out more than my body.

lines.zh: 别举着不动，我以为你要打。
lines.en: Hold it still and I think you are striking.
That is reasonably fresh.
Leave it. I will look later.
You hit my wing bone. Hard.
One hop and I am on the ledge.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开，占了很大地方。
lines.en: Wings open, I take up space.
On the ground I am clumsy.
You step back; I shake my wings.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，我掉了点绒毛。
lines.en: The bump costs me some fuzz.

lines.zh: 爪子在你手上划了一下。
lines.en: My claws rake your hand.
I turn and my wingtip catches you.
Wings tucked, I knock your hand aside.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，我飞得起来。
lines.en: Not heavy. I can still fly.
The brighter my crest, the better.
We nest high on the cliffs.
Good winds this season. Hurry.

lines.zh: 你从下往上看，看不见的。
lines.en: From below, you cannot see it.

lines.zh: 我的同类在更远的崖上。
lines.en: My kind are on farther cliffs.
My crest turns a brighter color.
Ground matters confuse me.
Eggs in the nest. Do not climb.

lines.zh: 我们靠冠的颜色认得彼此。
lines.en: We know each other by crest color.

lines.zh: 退开，这话题不适合地面。
lines.en: Back off. Not a topic for the ground.
I seize the meat with my claws.
I set down what you dropped.

lines.zh: 我在半空接住了一片叶。
lines.en: I catch a leaf in midair.
My talons grab twice, then give up.
I carry it up to the ledge.

lines.zh: 地上有东西在动，我先看。
lines.en: Something moves below. I look first.

lines.zh: 这块亮亮的，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Shiny. Not interested.
My claws cannot grip anything so small.
You take it. I will watch.
Once taken, I take off.
Crest forward, my talons spread.
You are below me. Good.
The thermal lifts me.
My shadow falls at your feet.

lines.zh: 我开始画圈，一圈比一圈低。
lines.en: I circle lower each time.
Hear the wing membrane?
This dive comes from behind.
Running makes you easy to see.
Wings low, I speed up.
The ground is too narrow to dodge.
I do not mean to land.
I'm already low behind you.

lines.zh: 头冠的影子，正好罩住你。
lines.en: My crest's shadow falls right on you.
Last stretch. Wings tucked.

lines.zh: 我绕着你不高不低地飞。
lines.en: I circle you at mid-height.
Each step back, I close in.
The wind favors me.

lines.zh: 头冠这么大，风一推就偏。
lines.en: A crest this big catches every gust.
Under a tree? Not enough.
I change angle, coming in from the side.

lines.zh: 我的影子在你脚下打转。
lines.en: My shadow turns under your feet.
You raise a hand; I climb.
You are heading for open ground. Perfect.
The wind holds me. No effort.
I circle slowly above your head.
Two more circles, then I come down.

lines.zh: 我的冠在阳光下很惹眼。
lines.en: My crest catches the light.
My wing tip carves an arc.
Perfect distance for one dive.
I dive and rake once.
My talons rake across your back.
My claws clamp your arm.

lines.zh: 这一下没落地，直接拉起。
lines.en: I pull up without landing.
My beak taps your armor.
The hit pushes you back a step.
I beat up a gust.

lines.zh: 这一扑只碰到你的袖子。
lines.en: That dive only caught your sleeve.
I am already climbing again.
You look up and I have passed.
No wound, and it still hurts.

lines.zh: 我不落地，你不容易还手。
lines.en: I do not land. Hard to strike back.
My claws slide off your shield.
One lap, then again.

lines.zh: 崖壁上多了一块彩色的影。
lines.en: A colored shape on the cliff.

lines.zh: 你听见翼膜张开的声音。
lines.en: The sound of a membrane opening.
I launch from the ledge.
One more arc in the sky.
The wind brings a pterosaur up.
My crest gleams at dawn.
I circle above the enclosure.
A large shadow on the ground.

lines.zh: 我从高处的岩缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a high crevice.
Good wind for takeoff here.

lines.zh: 我头上的冠，比身体还显眼。
lines.en: My crest is more striking than my body.
I pause on the canopy.
My wingtip skims the leaves.
The sky was empty. Not now.
I bank into the current.

lines.zh: 你听见一声短促的鸣叫。
lines.en: A short call.
Twenty blocks above you.
I land, wings folded.
Fire curls a corner of my membrane.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，摔在泥上。
lines.en: I fall from height into mud.

lines.zh: 翼膜一湿，我就飞不起来。
lines.en: Wet membrane and I cannot fly.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀翻了好几圈。
lines.en: The blast flips me over twice.

lines.zh: 翼膜破了个洞，我歪了一下。
lines.en: A hole in my wing membrane, I veer.
Magic ruins my sense of direction.
Long hunger keeps me low.

lines.zh: 雷光中，我的冠像块彩石。
lines.en: In lightning, my crest glows like stone.
No ground below. Only void.
